input: Learn to solve a Rubik's cube

gold.taskTitle: Learn to Solve a Rubik's Cube
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn how to solve a standard Rubik's cube from scratch.

questions.title: Do you currently own a physical Rubik's cube?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a cube available or needs to acquire one first.

questions.title: What is your current experience level with the cube?
questions.description: Find out if the user is a complete beginner, has tried before, or can already solve some layers.

questions.title: Which method do you want to learn — beginner or speedcubing?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a simple beginner layer-by-layer method or a faster advanced method like CFOP.

questions.title: Do you have a specific deadline for learning this?
questions.description: Understand if there is a target date, event, or personal milestone driving this goal.

questions.title: How much time per day can you dedicate to practice?
questions.description: Gauge daily availability to build a realistic and achievable practice schedule.

questions.title: Do you prefer learning through videos, written guides, or apps?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the most suitable resources.

questions.title: Is solving it once enough, or do you want to solve it fast?
questions.description: Determine whether the goal is simply to solve the cube once or to improve speed and consistency over time.
